serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services), service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative load from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no usable service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured, not zero
